justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/Addition.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/AdditionTest.java, plus sibling classes Multiplication.java and Subtraction.java for context. Addition is a compact enum with 4 constants, 2 fields, 1 constructor, and only 2 trivial methods (`isValid`, `apply`); it implements a single responsibility of emitting primitive-add opcodes and mirrors the same small structure used by related arithmetic classes, so there is no concrete evidence of insufficient modularization.
